google.loadFailed: Google sign-in could not be loaded. Check the connection and try again.
google.signInAgain: Sign in to Google again to sync.
google.popupBlocked: The browser blocked Google's sign-in window. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
google.denied: Google Drive was not connected: Touchdown was not allowed to use it.
google.notSignedIn: Google did not sign you in.
google.needsDrive: Touchdown needs permission to use its files in Google Drive. Sign in again and tick the box for Google Drive.
google.otherAccount: You signed in as {signedIn}, but this log is in the Google Drive of {account}. Sign in as {account}.
standard.error.noDrive: Google Drive was not connected: tick the box for Google Drive on Google's screen, so Touchdown can use its directory.
standard.error.noKey: Google did not give Touchdown a lasting key. Try again.
standard.error.expired: Connecting took too long, or began in another browser. Try again.
standard.error.failed: Connecting Google Drive did not work. Try again.
standard.error.unavailable: Standard mode is not available on this site.

invitation.message:
You are invited to Touchdown, a log of the flights you have flown on and the aircraft you have photographed.

Join here: {link}
The link works once, until {until}. There you choose how you sign in (a password or your Google account), then where your log is kept.

To add records from your computer, with the command line or an agent such as Claude Code or Codex, see {readme}.
